Revision (1), scope (`worked-example`) and block size (64) are likewise read from that module, not re-typed — an earlier pass with scope `engine-r1` produced 442 index bytes, so these constants determine the claim.

The script PRINTS measured values and asserts none of them. A drift therefore shows up as a diff line, which is what the verifier needs.
